description: Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 Mobile Platform adopts TSMC 4NM process which has 10% higher CPU peak performance and 20% higher GPU peak performance than Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1. GN5 sensor's dual pixel pro technology improves the autofocus function of the phone. The sensor is 50 MP in resolution.
